data.name: assistant.greeting
data.value: Hi! I'm your AI Assistant. I can help you quickly analyze energy efficiency. Please choose a function:

data.value: Sure, let me analyze interval energy efficiency for you

data.value: Please select a declaration item to analyze:

data.value: Selected "{name}". Please set the date range to analyze:

data.value: Average efficiency: cooling is 0, efficiency cannot be calculated.

data.value: Cooling data coverage is only {percent}% (below the {threshold}% threshold); "{leaf}" is missing {hours} hours. The figures above are for reference only.

data.name: assistant.verdict.good
data.value: Excellent efficiency. This circuit runs very efficiently — keep it up.

data.name: assistant.verdict.normal
data.value: Efficiency is within the normal range, with some room for optimization.

data.name: assistant.verdict.poor
data.value: Efficiency is on the high side. Consider checking chiller operation or load allocation — there may be saving opportunities.

data.name: assistant.verdict.low_coverage
data.value: Cooling data coverage is below the {threshold}% threshold, so no efficiency assessment is given for this range. Please check the data upload status of that point first.

data.name: assistant.verdict.insufficient
data.value: Insufficient data for this range; no efficiency assessment available yet.

data.value: The circuit bound to this item has been deleted. Please reconfigure it on the Energy Declaration page and try again.

data.name: assistant.error.generic
data.value: An error occurred during analysis. Please try again later.
